metadata.title: Seventies Soul Portrait with Neon Script

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, warm-toned facial close-up featuring heavy shadows and a vibrant, multi-layered neon script logo in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: warm low-key portrait with neon script
excludeWhen: clean modern minimalist photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, extreme close-up of a man's face in three-quarter view, characterized by deep shadows, warm amber skin tones, and a grainy film texture. The composition is anchored by a vibrant pink and green neon-style script logo positioned in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm, organic textures of the face contrast with the synthetic glow of the neon typography.
The tight crop creates an intimate, almost claustrophobic focus on the subject's eyes and beard.
The dark, shadowed background recedes to push the illuminated side of the face forward.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing that crops the top of the head and sides of the face.
Warm, saturated amber and brown color palette for the skin tones.
Neon-effect script lettering with a secondary offset color shadow.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies approximately 85% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the nose and the illuminated cheek serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright neon logo in the top left, follows the curve of the forehead down to the eyes, and rests on the textured beard.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the deep shadows of the hair and the upper left corner behind the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and ambers (skin and hair shadows).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant neon pink and emerald green (typography).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with very low value in the shadow areas, creating a chiaroscuro effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and neon accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with fluid, interconnected strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that loop
Parallel offset shadow in a contrasting color
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial capital letter features a large, sweeping loop that cradles the subsequent letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone decorative script; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn energy of the 70s.
Matches the tubular, glowing aesthetic of the logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, warm-toned close-up portrait of a man with a beard, using low-key lighting and deep amber shadows, with a hint of purple light on the right edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom neon-pink script logo in the upper left corner with a slight upward tilt and a green offset shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the crop tight enough to cut off the top of the head?
Does the skin have a warm, saturated amber glow?
Is the text rendered as a glowing neon script?
Is there a visible film grain texture across the image?

mustRedesign: Avoid using standard digital fonts; must look like custom hand-drawn neon.
Do not use flat lighting; must maintain deep shadows.
postGenerationChecks: Check for the green offset shadow on the pink text.
Ensure the eyes are visible but partially in shadow.
Verify the background is dark and non-distracting.
Confirm the overall color temperature is warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight warm portrait + neon script overlay + film grain.
